# BG1NPC malformed TPA file (unbalanced BEGIN/END - a stray extra END; weidu tolerates it, our grammar does not)

# D files using a %macro% as a standalone transition - the same class as the BAF templates above. The
# value comes from elsewhere in the install (a variable set in a .tp2 may reach a .d), so these are not
# valid on their own and weidu rejects them too. A %var% substituting a VALUE - a filename, a state
# label, a say text - is supported and needs no exclusion.
bg2-tweaks-and-tricks/tnt/components/faster_forging/botsmith.d
bg2-tweaks-and-tricks/tnt/components/faster_forging/wsmith01.d
rr/rr/rr_core/compile/rr#scrl.d
